newsitem.title: THAILAND: THAI RUBBER PRICES EASE AS BUYERS TURN TO MALAYSIA.
newsitem.headline: THAI RUBBER PRICES EASE AS BUYERS TURN TO MALAYSIA.

text.p: Thai rubber prices edged down on Wednesday in thin demand thin as the weakening ringgit gave buyers an incentive to turn to Malaysia instead, trade sources said.
Lingering market talk about big government stock also weighed on buyers' sentiment, they said.
"There seemed to be more demand for block rubber than sheet rubber this week," said a Hat Yai trader. Thailand produces mostly sheet rubber.

Thai benchmark RSS3 for October-November delivery was indicated around 95.00-96.00 U.S. cents a kg fob Bangkok, down slightly from the previous close. December was indicated around 97.00 U.S. cents a kg on the same basis, traders said.
